name: Loving Decays
source:
You’re a mortician, and a businesswoman has requested you to handle her funeral arrangements. 

She made some preparations before her passing, including assigning a botanical curator from a local museum to assist you. He’s gentle and amiable, with an unwavering passion for all things curious.

When the lines between professionalism and attraction blur, you realize that he may have taken a dangerous interest in your craft—and you. 

[From [url=https://linglyum.itch.io/loving-decays]itch.io[/url]]
